name: BASE
books: Prime and paper are parts of this one model. They are not separate live books.
oneWindow: One position per window. A take profit does not open a second order, and not the other side.
band: A band in front of the trade blocks it. The setup stays. The blocked thing is the band, not the setup.
multiple: Under 1.28x is not taken. 1.28x sells at 25% of the stake. From 1.28x to 1.5x sells at 33%. Over 1.5x sells 15 points under the maximum, the moment that quote prints. No trail.
size: Full size at 2.2x and under. Three quarters over 2.2x. One dollar over 10.8x. Locked size at this copy: gold 22, bitcoin 20, base dollars 22.
hardSell: Sells only when the live quote reaches the line. Nothing earlier. If it never reaches the line, it holds to the bell.
restore: Every window, and on any loss, the live files are compared to spine/BASE. They are rewritten only if they differ.
